firstPlayerRule: The most recent visitor to China goes first. If nobody has visited, choose randomly.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give the starting player the engineer token. Turns proceed clockwise.
Random selection when nobody has visited China is part of the official rule.
This criterion selects the multiplayer starter. The Yin & Yang solo variant has its own setup and turn sequence.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://thundergryph.com/product/tang-garden/. Finding: The most recent visitor to China goes first. If nobody has visited, choose randomly. Local source SHA-256: 82aa045bcf23a7f04aff8caea6fbf6c6f2180c246bb1d278c4d5e58f442d814c. The publisher product supplies the English retail PDF; the final page shows ©2019. The random alternative covers nobody having visited, not a stated tie between simultaneous visitors. Scoring tie-breaks on page 9 are unrelated to starting order.
uncertainty: No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
